text: 10 OVERDOSAGE There have been no reports of significant overdose of KAPIDEX. Multiple doses of KAPIDEX 120 mg and a single dose of KAPIDEX 300 mg did not result in death or other severe adverse events. Dexlansoprazole is not expected to be removed from the circulation by hemodialysis. If an overdose occurs, treatment should be symptomatic and supportive.
